host.description: AXIS camera host or IP. Injected per target at runtime from credential rules / SRQL-scoped targets or derived from the relay source URL; not configured per assignment.

username.description: Camera API username. Stored on a username/password credential secret, not on this assignment.

password.description: Camera API password. Stored on a credential secret, not on this assignment.

rtsp_port.description: RTSP port (appended to the stream URL only when non-standard)

relay.description: Injected relay session context from the agent streaming runtime
